name: 27405 · Greensboro, NC
findings: ZIP 27405 (Greensboro) has 210 nonprofit organizations. 71 of them (34%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 52 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 27405 (Greensboro) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
